description: Resize an image to the given width and/or height, preserving aspect ratio, and write it to the output path.

height.description: Target height in pixels. Optional; at least one of width and height is required, and aspect ratio is preserved.

input.description: Path to the source image file to resize.

output.description: Path where the resized image will be written.

width.description: Target width in pixels. Optional; at least one of width and height is required, and aspect ratio is preserved.

name: resize_image
